attempted_derivation.blocking_gap: The Yang-Mills boundary OPE must produce H and a uniform projected remainder for the locked Wilson core, especially in the semidefinite H case.
steps: Normalize N_delta and B_delta to unit diagonal; additive contacts are excluded by diagonal trace continuity and positivity.
The intended t=0 OS matrix is q_delta=Nhat_delta oslash Bhat_delta; closed-cone positivity of N_delta alone does not imply q_delta>=0.
Insert q_delta=J+lambda_delta H+R_delta and project with P onto 1^perp, where J vanishes exactly.
For x in 1^perp, a negative x*Hx dominates the o(lambda_delta) remainder, giving x*q_delta*x<0 for small delta.
attempted_derivation.why_not_yet_a_proof: This is a conditional finite-matrix lemma; it does not prove the needed Wilson collar expansion or positivity of H on a dense same-theory algebra.

assumptions: A fixed finite Wilson collar family F_i(delta) has positive diagonals; Bhat_delta has unit diagonal and no zero entry.
Collar reflection positivity gives Nhat_delta>=0, and diagonal trace continuity has killed additive contacts.
The same-theory plane OS block is q_delta=Nhat_delta oslash Bhat_delta, not a newly renormalized boundary algebra.
q_delta is Hermitian and admits q_delta=J+lambda_delta H+R_delta with lambda_delta down to 0 and ||P R_delta P||=o(lambda_delta).
definitions: source object: finite reflected Wilson collar OS matrices N_delta from regulated reflection-positive Schwinger forms, plus boundary multiplicative matrices B_delta after additive contacts are removed.
target object: normalized continuum OS matrices M for the locked gauge-invariant Wilson algebra, including reflection-plane limits of collar observables.
controlled interface: Hadamard Schur preimage q_delta=Nhat_delta oslash Bhat_delta and its rank-one tangent on the zero-sum subspace.

same-theory condition: Wilson embeddings, diagonal renormalizations, and boundary trace map are fixed before the limit; no pair-dependent counterterm, quotient algebra, or new boundary state is inserted.

equations.valid_when: valid when B entries are nonzero and all allowed boundary renormalization is already encoded in B.

equations.label: rank-one tangent
equations.valid_when: valid for a Wilson block whose boundary OPE has a first nontrivial quotient coefficient H.

equations.label: zero-sum obstruction
equations.valid_when: valid under the tangent expansion; x*Hx<0 makes q_delta negative for small delta.

candidate_lemmas.failure_test: Compute H for reflected Wilson hairpins; any zero-sum vector with x*Hx<0 is a falsifier of the collar-to-plane bridge.
candidate_lemmas.proof_role: Converts the boundary OPE coefficient into a first-order necessary test for same-theory OS positivity, before invoking log-CND or Hadamard semigroups.
candidate_lemmas.statement: Zero-sum Wilson quotient tangent lemma: if normalized same-theory Schur preimages q_delta for reflected Wilson collars satisfy q_delta=J+lambda_delta H+o(lambda_delta), lambda_delta>0, then valid OS positivity forces H>=0 on 1^perp; a negative zero-sum form is a finite Wilson falsifier.

control_decision.pivot_test: Pivot if a concrete hairpin OPE gives negative H on 1^perp or a negative three-block quotient determinant.
control_decision.promotion_test: Promote if H is PSD on 1^perp with uniform remainders for a dense locked Wilson core, and local mirror-flat observables remain trace-continuous.
control_decision.reason: The branch now has an exact finite Schur-preimage bridge plus a sharper infinitesimal detector tied to Wilson boundary OPE data.

dependency_updates.description: Closed-cone passage is valid on collars; plane passage reduces to finite Schur-preimage positivity and its zero-sum tangent.
Topology must control boundary-OPE tangent coefficients and projected remainders for reflected Wilson collars.
Wilson core must be fixed before collar removal; otherwise quotient positivity may prove a modified boundary theory.

falsifiers: falsifier: a reflected hairpin OPE coefficient H with x*Hx<0 for some zero-sum x makes the intended OS block indefinite.
falsifier: pairwise quotient tests pass but a three-Wilson determinant det(Nhat oslash Bhat)<0 due to quotient phase holonomy.
falsifier: B_delta has zeros or uncontrolled phases, so the Hadamard preimage is not a valid same-theory matrix.
falsifier: a residual additive contact with zero diagonal survives, contradicting positive-contact Cauchy-Schwarz and diagonal trace continuity.
branch_outputs.mathematical_learning: Cycle 214 learned that near rank-one Wilson quotient blocks, the first OS obstruction lives exactly on 1^perp. The leading boundary OPE coefficient H is a computable necessary test; a negative zero-sum form is a valid finite falsifier without assuming log-CND.
branch_outputs.next_experiment: Compute the leading quotient kernel H for three reflected Wilson hairpins sharing a boundary footprint; test zero-sum quadratic forms before trying log-CND.
